issues.title: [OAC-01] Independently review residual-block collapse
issues.body:
## Objective

Check whether both DNS05 residual modes reduce to one shared nonlinear basis and linear readout.

## Why it matters

This determines whether current block count measures neural depth.

## Inputs

Frozen source: `1193a33760e7367f55fcd2d938a0add0d77c8b20` ([browse](https://github.com/Erchard/direct-network-synthesis/tree/1193a33760e7367f55fcd2d938a0add0d77c8b20)).

src/dns/synthesis/dns05_kernel_compiler.py; tests/test_synthesis.py; docs/audits/oac-01-residual-collapse.md

## Allowed data

Listed source/docs and published aggregate result records; primary literature where relevant; deterministic synthetic unit fixtures only. No benchmark execution.

## Forbidden/protected data

All raw benchmark train/validation/test partitions, new test outcomes, private data and credentials. Do not run any historical experiment runner.

## Command and resource bound

```text
python -m pytest tests/test_synthesis.py
```

Up to two hours of contributor work; stop with an explicit partial report at that limit. No remote compute or paid services required.

## Expected output

An independent derivation or counterexample tied to source, with synthetic identity checks.

## Acceptance criteria

Cover full and partitioned bases, readout absorption, uneven and zero-rank cases; distinguish equal fitted functions from equal ridge training.

## Failure/falsification criteria

A valid counterexample overturns the local audit. Report no counterexample found without claiming universal depth collapse.

## Artifact destination

issues.title: [OAC-11] Independently reproduce frozen DNS05-FMSA validation results
issues.body:
## Objective

Reproduce the frozen FMSA run in a separate environment without changing candidates, seeds or selection.

## Why it matters

The mixed-to-negative result needs independent execution, including failures.

## Inputs

Frozen source: `1193a33760e7367f55fcd2d938a0add0d77c8b20` ([browse](https://github.com/Erchard/direct-network-synthesis/tree/1193a33760e7367f55fcd2d938a0add0d77c8b20)).

configs/dns05_failure_scaling_audit.json; docs/dns05-failure-scaling-audit-protocol.md; docs/results/dns05_failure_scaling_audit.json; original evaluation commit c4c0a36f95f7b475506e94ad508ce297067b4993

## Allowed data

Only train and validation portions designated by the frozen FMSA protocol; generation/split/feature seeds exactly as its config. Existing published results may be compared. Use the original recorded Python 3.12.14, NumPy 2.5.2 and scikit-learn 1.9.0 when available; record SciPy/BLAS/thread versions/settings and any environment mismatch. The original artifact does not fully pin the environment; do not hide that limitation.

## Forbidden/protected data

No test transforms, predictions, scores, test-based selection or changes to the frozen excluded partitions. Do not run historical confirmation commands. No private data or credentials.

## Command and resource bound

```text
python -m experiments.run_dns05_failure_scaling --config configs/dns05_failure_scaling_audit.json --output results/oac-11-fmsa-reproduction.json
```

One complete frozen run, capped at 30 minutes and 8 GiB process RAM; no candidate changes.

## Expected output

A complete result record, environment manifest, hash and discrepancy report from a separate machine or isolated clean environment.

## Acceptance criteria

Preserve all 15 declared splits and all variants; compare discrete selections, row identities, and per-split accuracy exactly. Compare non-timing floating metrics with rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-8. Differences remain reportable, not grounds to tune. Timings are descriptive by hardware, not pass/fail thresholds.

## Failure/falsification criteria

Stop at 30 minutes elapsed or 8 GiB process memory, record partial output and limitation. Missing packages or differing BLAS behavior must be reported. No reruns seeking a better seed or changed tolerance. An unsuccessful reproduction is valid evidence.

## Artifact destination

`docs/reproductions/oac-11/<contributor>/ (report, environment and complete result record with provenance)`
